title: tap-iostat: Support filters with internal commas
description:
The TShark -z io,stat tap supports multiple filters separated by
commas, but the filter grammar has commas, which can be located
inside delimiters (quoted strings, slices, sets, and function params.)
If parsing a filter fails when splitting on a comma, try the filter
at the next comma location until we run out.

Since commas only appear within delimiter pairs, splitting at the
wrong location always results in an unbalanced and invalid filter.
That is, there can only be at most one possible valid interpretation
of the option argument. If the filter grammar ever changes to allow
commas in other places, then there will be ambiguity (and possibly
the seprator would have to change.)

Also clean up some unnecessary casts, switch the order of g_strstrip
and g_strdup so we're not altering a const char* via casting away
constness, free some things on exit so LSan doesn't report leaks,
and add some comments.

Fix #20212
